_comment: Normalized names that are never a product. Open Food Facts is crowd-edited,
so it carries test entries, placeholders and the odd bare word typed into
Compared after normalizeSearchText, so entries are lowercase and
diacritic-free. Whole-name matches only -- a name merely CONTAINING 'test'
Structural junk is handled by rules in normalize/, not listed here: names
that are all digits, shorter than 3 characters, or contain a URL.
